Nina Park: Heads-up  Candidate Priya Menon (Product Designer) is in Adelaide (ACST, GMT+9:30). She's available Thu Sep 9 between 18:30-22:30 ACST (00:00-04:00 PT). Candidate asked about a childcare stipend for coming onsite and whether we can prepay a rideshare. Can people-ops advise?
Luis Ortega: We have a childcare reimbursement policy for interview travel: up to $100 USD with receipt. Rideshare prepay isn't standard but we can offer a rideshare credit via our vendor if pre-approved. Need candidate's email and preferred pickup address.
Hannah Cho: I can own logistics. Priya prefers remote first (video), then potentially onsite tour same day if screening passes. She requested a private nursing-friendly waiting space and also asked if we can schedule interviews no earlier than 19:00 ACST due to childcare drop-off.
Nina Park: Candidate details: priya.m@example.com, passport name Priya S. Menon, phone +61 412 345 678. She asked if the childcare stipend needs prior approval or can be submitted after.
people-ops-bot: Policy note: childcare during interview travel is reimbursable up to $100 USD; submit receipt to expenses@redwood.com with tag 'interview-childcare' within 30 days. For pre-approved rideshare credits, submit a request to people-ops@redwood.com 48h prior. Link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/travel-reimbursements (internal).
Luis Ortega: I'll request a one-time rideshare credit for the candidate if Hannah confirms pickup address and ETA. Childcare stipend: candidate can submit after travel; no pre-approval needed if under $100.
Hannah Cho: Proposed schedule (ACST): 19:00-19:40 remote interview 1, 19:50-20:30 remote interview 2, 21:00 quick debrief for onsite decision. Onsite tour tentative at 14:00 PT (same day) if invited. Will include note about nursing-friendly waiting space.
facilities-bot: Note: nursing-friendly room available at Mountain View office (Room N1). To reserve, send request to office-ops@redwood.com 24h in advance. Parking: short-term guest drop-off available.
Nina Park: I'll message Priya to confirm whether she wants rideshare credit and childcare stipend info. Also asked candidate to confirm if printed badge is required if she visits.
Hannah Cho: Calendar invites drafted; included childcare stipend instructions and a line: "If you need a rideshare prepay please reply to this invite and people-ops will follow up."
people-ops-bot: Candidate profile updated: "Priya Menon - ACST; childcare reimbursement guidance sent; potential rideshare credit request pending; nursing-friendly room noted."
Luis Ortega: Action items: Hannah to confirm pickup address by EOD Tue; Nina to confirm candidate preference on onsite; people-ops to process rideshare credit if requested.
Nina Park: Priya confirmed she would like a rideshare credit and will send pickup address. Thanks team :raised_hands:
